cases.mechanism_detail: A complex 5'-truncated L1HS insertion (part antisense, part sense) in exon 12, inherited from the father and compound heterozygous with R1606X, appears to destroy the exon 12 acceptor; RT-PCR shows in-frame transcripts skipping all of exon 12 or lacking its first 66 bp via an alternative internal acceptor.
cases.quote: Transcripts missing the first 66 bp of exon 12 as well as transcripts with loss of the complete exon 12 were detected.
